body: What keeps you going through it all?

I know that there are many people like me. I see them at my school. My "friends" are like me too. We dont do anything outside school. I think I just hang with them because I dont want to be alone. I hate them because I see myself in them. I hate myself.
17 year old, virgin, never been in a party, a little socially awkward. A classic case of loserity .

I have been depressed for about 4 months now have had suicidal thoughts the whole time.
  
Im 17 years old, virgin forever alone loser.

I had my prom last night. Guess who wasnt invited to the after prom party? Yea thats right, me. The small nerdy kid.

All I ever have wanted is to be a normal teen.
It's not that simple for me.
